neighbours.label: ' full' counting a complete time period after an ordinal or last: 'first full season', 'last full year'
fire: The new coach enters his first full campaign with the team in August.
2004 was the last full year before the factory shut down for good.
Next year will be her first full term as mayor of the city.
The startup just closed its first full quarter of paid sales.
This was the team's second full season in the top division.
We got through our first full month in the new house without a single leak.
Monday marks the first full day of the new ceasefire.
It was their last full week of classes before exams began.
quiet: The new coach signed a contract with the team in August.
2004 was the year before the factory shut down for good.
The mayor's office is full of boxes and old campaign posters.
The startup closed its books with full payment of all sales.
The team's second bus was full for the trip to the top division game.
We got through the whole month in the new house without a single leak.
Monday marks the anniversary of the new ceasefire.
The parking lot was full all week before exams began.

notes: Probe: 'full' in the sense of filled stayed under 0.03. 'In its first season' without ' full' reached 0.28, so ordinal plus period alone may leak.
